title: Approved Minimal Design: Single-Parameter Degree Scaling

verdict.summary: PASS PARSIMONY GATE: Single degree-aware scaling parameter beats tuned 2-layer GCN by +0.034 macro-F1 over the 0.718 baseline [run_logs/t3_13_minimal.json].

parsimony_check.simplest_alternative: Tuned 2-layer GCN baseline (0.718 macro-F1 across 5 seeds)

key_evidence.claim: Tuned 2-layer GCN baseline scores 0.718 macro-F1 under degree shift.
Adding 1 degree-scaling parameter raises macro-F1 to 0.752 (+0.034).

flaws_and_risks.summary: Evaluation covers citation graphs only; external industrial graphs remain untested.

next_steps.action: Run frozen 5-seed evaluation on held-out split and verify SHA-256 receipts.
